wisc-lymphoma-half-body-rt-chop.identity: UW Phase I high-dose-rate half-body radiotherapy on top of CHOP-25, 3+3 dose escalation with two fractions per body half.
wisc-lymphoma-half-body-rt-chop.recruitment_sites: Exact September 2026 reference sheet gives active candidate enrollment pathway at UW Veterinary Care Radiation Oncology, Madison. Access to general roster remains restricted.
wisc-lymphoma-half-body-rt-chop.eligibility: Canine large-cell multicentric stage III+, B or T, treatment naive before CHOP, currently in CHOP and partial/complete remission after two cycles (week 9); excludes progression or medical inability to tolerate anesthesia/CHOP.
wisc-lymphoma-half-body-rt-chop.funding: Study pays RT/anesthesia/boarding for RT and two CBC, chemistry and urinalysis panels; owner pays CHOP, routine follow-up, extra tests and adverse-event care.
wisc-lymphoma-half-body-rt-chop.contacts: Michelle Turek and Mackenzie Pellin, co-I Rey Chi; radonc@vetmed.wisc.edu / 608-263-7600.
wisc-lymphoma-half-body-rt-chop.deadline: No published recruitment end; CHOP weeks are relative to enrollment.

msu-hs-quasiorganelle.identity: MSU experimental Listeria-derived quasiorganelle treatment alone or with gene therapy, two separately named arms with 16-week treatment plan.
msu-hs-quasiorganelle.recruitment_sites: MSU current oncology roster and individual official clinical page, East Lansing MI only.
msu-hs-quasiorganelle.eligibility: Confirmed HS including hemophagocytic, visible ≤5 lesions with sum <15cm, ≥20kg, VCOG ≤2, organ function adequate. No specific concurrent disease, wound, immunodeficiency; systemic antibiotics/immune suppression, prednisone/chemo/RT washouts as published. Avoid pregnancy exposure in home.
msu-hs-quasiorganelle.funding: All protocol tests/treatments and protocol-related complications covered after enrollment. Initial consult and unrelated care owner-paid.
msu-hs-quasiorganelle.deadline: No published enrollment cutoff. 16 weeks is assigned treatment.

msu-feline-mammary-met.identity: MSU miR-10b-targeted experimental therapeutic for feline metastatic mammary carcinoma with serial CT/MRI.
msu-feline-mammary-met.recruitment_sites: Current MSU oncology listing and named individual protocol, East Lansing MI.
msu-feline-mammary-met.eligibility: Cat with confirmed mammary carcinoma plus metastasis and documented miR-10b overexpression; nonulcerated external lesion ≤8 cm³ total, reasonable organ function and expected survival >4 weeks. Prior surgery/chemo and concurrent NSAIDs may be allowed.
msu-feline-mammary-met.funding: Investigational therapeutic and associated imaging covered; unrelated care/testing owner-paid.
msu-feline-mammary-met.deadline: No dated intake cutoff; up to 12 months is follow-up.

ca-ovc-feline-oscc-porphysome-pdt.identity: Michelle Oblak exact feline oral subproject of Porphysome nanoparticle phototherapy; separate canine protocol listed On Hold.
ca-ovc-feline-oscc-porphysome-pdt.recruitment_sites: Current feline treatment subproject on organizer OVC clinical page, University of Guelph Ontario.
ca-ovc-feline-oscc-porphysome-pdt.eligibility: Confirmed feline oral cavity squamous cell carcinoma; further protocol screening requirements not publicly enumerated.
ca-ovc-feline-oscc-porphysome-pdt.funding: Current official protocol does not itemize study-covered and owner-paid costs.
ca-ovc-feline-oscc-porphysome-pdt.contacts: OVC clinical trials, ovc.clinicaltrials@uoguelph.ca and official study contact.

jp-multicenter-oral-melanoma-anti-pd1-20.identity: Japanese registration trial of caninized anti-canine PD-1 antibody for confirmed oral malignant melanoma; not previous 150-dog research or Hokkaido PD-L1.
jp-multicenter-oral-melanoma-anti-pd1-20.recruitment_sites: All three published trial sites in organizer and Yamaguchi confirmation: Japan Small Animal Cancer Center Tokorozawa, Yamaguchi University VMC, and Kamogawa Animal Medical Center Kyoto. Exact regional site restrictions kept.
jp-multicenter-oral-melanoma-anti-pd1-20.eligibility: Diagnosed oral malignant melanoma in dogs; site clinical state/staging and restricted meds; pathology/cytology needed, six visits every two weeks. No unverified numeric stage or size criterion.
jp-multicenter-oral-melanoma-anti-pd1-20.funding: Organizer explicitly says cost burden is explained individually; no promised coverage or owner price published.
jp-multicenter-oral-melanoma-anti-pd1-20.contacts: Kamogawa referral/owner form and 075-600-2552; separate Yamaguchi clinical contacts in official three-site notice.
jp-multicenter-oral-melanoma-anti-pd1-20.deadline: Enrollment started August 2026; no published closing date.

korea-vaxleukin15-mammary-2026.identity: Current manufacturer VCB-2401 Vaxleukin-15 canine immunoadjuvant with surgery in mammary tumor treatment, product access not trial.
korea-vaxleukin15-mammary-2026.recruitment_sites: Korean prescription pathway through manufacturer/Yuhan, not enrollment at a trial site and no care directory import.
korea-vaxleukin15-mammary-2026.eligibility: Dog with appropriate mammary tumor and standard surgery planned or completed; feline indications not approved.
korea-vaxleukin15-mammary-2026.funding: Commercial cost not published; no study subsidy asserted.
korea-vaxleukin15-mammary-2026.deadline: No recruitment cutoff applicable to approved commercial access.

korea-vaxleukin15-lymphoma-2026.identity: Current manufacturer VCB-2401 Vaxleukin-15 canine lymphoma adjunct with standard chemotherapy, not mammary surgical protocol or research enrollment.
korea-vaxleukin15-lymphoma-2026.recruitment_sites: Korean prescription pathway through manufacturer/Yuhan, not independent clinical trial intake.
korea-vaxleukin15-lymphoma-2026.eligibility: Dog with lymphoma as adjunct to chemotherapy; prescribing clinician assesses phenotype, plans and drug risks. No prior surgery requirement.
korea-vaxleukin15-lymphoma-2026.funding: No official commercial price or trial subsidy published.
